As someone who did MKT412, MKT465, MKT330 and MKT382, I would recommend you to take courses based on what you will be learning rather than just getting an A/A- in the course. Of course grades are important but so is learning.
MKT412 (ZTK) I found this course pretty easy. It is mostly about making processes and designing the services of a business. So it is more about the backend part of a business and its marketing. If you think that you are creative enough then it's actually a pretty good course to do so, under ZTK ma'am. There's SeH Ma'am as well. You can take her section too. It's a bit competitive to get a good grade in this course but nothing impossible at all.
MKT330 (Ehn) This course is a lot different from others (Well, every course is different) but there are a couple of contents you might find similar to the previous courses you have done. But man oh man! Ehn Sir literally teaches you how to run ads and campaigns, even how to do A/B testing as well, practically. It might be a bit competitive to get a good grade in this course if you are taking Ehn Sir's section but yeah you gotta give in a lot of effort.
Now rest is up to you. Choose and decide wisely!
